message:
0.2.0.3: measure muffle gain against the stable vanilla mixer baseline

Rehearsal 40665961543 passed three profiles and exposed a pre-existing audio smoke assumption in latest API: MUSIC gain was 0.082074516 instead of the assumed 0.16. The 26.3 reference bytecode shows MusicManager.fadePlaying independently updates SoundEngine gainBySource for MUSIC.

Compare muffled and unmuffled engine readings within one client task, then restart the cue for the existing expiry assertions. Preserve the exact multiplicative-gain assertion on every bus and its original 0.001 tolerance. No production audio code changes.

Verified release sample at the same player code: world ZIP 385,064 bytes, JAR 1,328,349 bytes, H.264 MP4 535,751 bytes (155.5 seconds). Keep the 2 MiB budget.96 Python tests, story and contract checks, and javacheck133 sources pass.
